result.locked_model: Sum of split (asymmetric) pseudo-Voigt profiles, one per Bragg reflection, on a SNIP background (snip_iterations='auto'). eta (Gaussian-Lorentzian mixing) free per peak in [0,1]. Expected ~7–9 significant reflections: ~11.0°, ~17.7°, ~18.6°, ~19.2° (weak), ~22.2° (strong), ~24.6° (weak/borderline), ~26.0° (broad), ~29.5°, plus weaker high-angle features. Peaks within 1.5×FWHM (the 17.7/18.6/19.2 cluster) are fit jointly within the single global model.
